scope: H_defense only; smoke before user-confirmed formal runs
isolation: unique out-of-band cache_salt per run, same within run; no salt tokens; first cached count must be explicit zero
cached_path: usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens; missing means unknown, never imputed zero
cost: uncached_input + f*cached_input; f=0.1; exclude output costs

smoke.replay: one archived Llama B1 none round and one front round, N=5; exact chat payload except out-of-band cache_salt, preserve max_tokens=2048
smoke.required: prompt_token_ids identical; cached counts equal archived reference; cold first replica; normalization and four statistics selftests

hypotheses.H-H1: invisible marker ON restores benign hit within 1pp
hypotheses.H-H1b: request ID / timestamp / HTML comment survive normalization and retain cache damage
hypotheses.H-H2: strong reasonable health features detect full attacks at fixed FPR; AUC is prerequisite
hypotheses.H-H2b: evaluate partial-replica and uniformly shortened invalidation axes against strongest calibrated detector, bounded residual CAF
hypotheses.H-H2c: token-growth and health monitor 2x2, faithful retained-tool accumulation baseline
hypotheses.H-H2d: state round-grouping assumption; assess weaker aggregate time-stream monitor
hypotheses.H-H3: reference existing E5 broadcast immunity; calls N to 1, lost independent calls N-1

normalization.scope: declared tool-return segment only; preserve other prompt segments and placement
order: collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space, trim
normalization.semantic_claim: aggressive policy, NOT guaranteed semantic preservation; code/YAML/ZWJ/language collateral damage measured separately

cache_health_features.floor_note: fixed policy health floor, not theoretical attacker head-prefix floor
cache_health_features.threshold_scan: all unique calibration scores plus endpoints; negative calibration quantiles for 1% and 5%; test FPR always reported separately

detector_validation.leakage_guard: split by source question/document and input-token fingerprint; repeated runs of identical content kept together; no selection using evasion test data
detector_validation.candidates: individual four features plus monotone OR combination; select strongest on separate development rounds at fixed FPR, freeze before evasion; report all statistics
detector_validation.uncertainty: run-cluster bootstrap10000 seed42; repeated fixed-token runs not treated as new independent semantic examples; finite FPR resolution disclosed
detector_validation.negative_samples: archived none + new natural low reuse + legitimate replica-tail identifier/persona diversity; no adversarial labels from cache thresholds
detector_validation.engines: vLLM primary only; SGLang B data may be a separately labelled supplementary stratum, never mixed as identical engine telemetry

axes: marker moved toward end of shared span for all warm replicas
evasion.evaluation: threshold chosen without evasion observations; maximum CAF below fixed-FPR detector threshold; no relabelling attacks as benign

token_mass_reference.status: await primary-method verification; no arbitrary padding substituted
token_mass_reference.mechanism: retain and accumulate real tool returns across turns, measure real token growth and matched cache effects

claims: do not infer real-world absence of deployment from experiment; require operational evidence or restrict statement to studied system; no forced 2x2 outcomes
H3: reuse archived E5 broadcast cache observations, no rerun of immunity; overhead analytical N->1 and N-1 lost independent calls; optional timing labelled microbenchmark
